prompts.prompt:
STYLE GUIDE (apply to every asset):
Top-down 3/4 perspective pixel art for a 2D mystery/investigation game, in the readable, cozy-clean style of classic farming/life-sim pixel games, but dark and atmospheric.
Setting: an original foggy Victorian-era industrial city called Kettlegate with occult undertones: cobblestone streets, gas lamps, soot-stained brick, wrought iron, canals, chapels, secret societies, alchemical potions.
Grid: strict 16x16 pixel tiles. Overworld characters are 16x32 pixels per frame. Every pixel must align to the grid; no half pixels, no sub-pixel detail.
Pixels: crisp hard-edged pixels, no anti-aliasing, no blur, no gradients; deliberate 2-tone checker dithering only on large surfaces or for fake transparency. 1px dark outline in deep blue-grey (around #1a1c2c, not pure black) on characters, props and icons; terrain tiles have no outline.
Palette: limited muted palette of max 32 colors, matching the existing game sprites. Desaturated slate blues, fog greys, soot browns, mossy greens, rust and brass, bone white; warm amber/yellow only for gas lamp light and candles; turquoise #6fe0d0 or deep violet reserved for occult/supernatural things. Avoid saturated primaries and pure black/white.
Lighting: flat base colors with 2-3 shade steps; light from top-left. Do not bake night darkness into sprites (the engine adds lighting).
Mood: melancholic, mysterious, slightly unsettling, never gory.
Output: transparent background (PNG with alpha) unless stated otherwise, orthographic, no text, no letters, no numbers, no watermark, no signature.
Avoid: 3D render look, painterly style, photorealism, chibi exaggeration, anime eyes, references to existing games, films or franchises.
Create one production sprite atlas, exactly TEN COLUMNS and FOUR ROWS, 40 distinct circular combat skill icons. Canvas aspect 2.5:1, perfectly regular equal square cells, no gutters or labels. Each cell represents exactly 16x16 native pixels enlarged with NEAREST NEIGHBOR. Fill each cell with a centered 14x14 round dark blue-grey medallion and transparent corners. Reference images are style reference only. Prioritize extremely simple readable 1px strokes and chunky 2-3-tone symbols, NOT intricate illustrations. Each icon has a small upper-left rim highlight and two symbolic elements. Every row must be different. Column colors, left to right: amber #e8b860, lilac #c8b0e8, rose #e07a8a, turquoise #6fe0d0, poison green #9ad06a, steel #a8b4c0, brass #d0a050, dull gold #c9a84c and lead grey #7d7f8a, peat #6b4a2e and moss #5f7a4a, copper #b8783c and ivory #e6dcc3.
Row 1 (sequence 4), left to right: 1 flaming candle over judgment scales; 2 needle across stitched seam; 3 mask with detached second cheek; 4 bell with lingering sound arc; 5 flask with sediment at its base; 6 riveted hammer striking weight; 7 key cutting a door threshold diagonally; 8 pawn token above protective shield; 9 three peat strata under downward pressure; 10 clock ring with a missing wedge.
Row 2 (sequence 3): 1 flame over ash-filled dish; 2 broken thread joined by staple; 3 two overlapping theatrical masks; 4 bell with trailing mourning ribbon; 5 two curved arrows around a potion flask; 6 steel buttress bracing a block; 7 unlatched bolt crossing empty keyhole; 8 balance scale crossed by an impact line; 9 hand emerging from sediment layers; 10 clock hand like a thrusting spear. Add one tiny turquoise or violet spark in every icon of this row.
Row 3 (sequence 2): 1 horizontal light blade across smoky horizon; 2 needle pulling curved fabric hem; 3 empty theatrical stage under small mask; 4 sound arcs crossing a shoreline; 5 steaming cauldron above heat bars; 6 triangular riveted truss with thrust arrow; 7 key leaping over broken doorway rim; 8 two opposed weights linked by crossing arcs; 9 muddy bank with healing reed; 10 returning curved arrow around clock hammer. Add one tiny occult spark each.
Row 4 (sequence 1): 1 open lantern radiating light; 2 open knot with four loose ends; 3 single unmasked face beneath stage rays; 4 listening ear inside final sound ring; 5 last luminous drop over distillation vessel; 6 massive pillar under steel shield; 7 open door with key and light beyond; 8 blank torn receipt with weight and seal, NO marks resembling writing; 9 empty silhouette in soil encircled by roots; 10 open pocket watch releasing a clock hand. Each has one turquoise spark and one single bright ivory core pixel.
No text anywhere. No extra cells. No internal padding beyond one native pixel. Exact 10x4 arrangement.

Create one production sprite atlas, exactly THREE COLUMNS and FIVE ROWS, 15 distinct circular combat skill icons. Canvas aspect 3:5. Perfectly regular equal square cells, no gutters or labels. Each cell represents exactly 16x16 native pixels enlarged NEAREST NEIGHBOR. Each icon a centered 14x14 dark blue-grey round medallion with transparent corners and 1px outline, upper-left highlight. Very simple strong chunky symbols, only 2-3 tones each, readable at sixteen pixels. Reference image is style reference only.
Column 1 Waage: dull gold #c9a84c with lead grey #7d7f8a.
Column 2 Moor: peat brown #6b4a2e with moss green #5f7a4a.
Column 3 Uhr: copper #b8783c with ivory #e6dcc3.
Row 1 (sequence 9): gold pawn token pressed down onto shield; muddy hand rising from peat; simple clock face with impact tick.
Row 2 (sequence 8): two suspended counterweights on a balance beam; blank grave marker sinking into mossy ground, no writing; clock hand with right-pointing advance arrow.
Row 3 (sequence 7): pledge coin suspended by short chain; three compressed peat strata with downward wedge; swinging pendulum with curved return arc.
Row 4 (sequence 6): tilted balance struck diagonally; open healing hand beside river bank and reed; two small interlocking clock gears.
Row 5 (sequence 5): closed blank ledger with pawn token seal, absolutely no writing; closed stack of peat layers sealed with small root; hourglass encircled by curved return arrow.
Exactly 3 columns, 5 rows. NO letters, numbers, pseudo-text, labels. Do not add occult sparks to these lower-level icons. All fifteen motifs distinct.

postprocessing: Equal-cell crop; nearest-neighbor 16x16; shared indexed palette; alpha threshold 128; canonical circular 1px outline and upper-left glint; sequence 3-1 occult spark and sequence 1 ivory core.
sourceStorage: Image-generator masters normalized cell-by-cell with nearest neighbor to the exact target grid; original full-resolution generations are not required for reproduction.
